function: above_phy: the DRL agent controls UAV trajectories, user-UAV and UAV-satellite pairing, the final aggregation satellite, and aggregation weights (p. 7).
notes: Excluded as above_phy, not no_learning, because a learned component exists (the DSAC agent, p. 7) and it acts above the physical layer. The action a(t) holds only UAV trajectory, user-UAV pairing, UAV-satellite pairing, final aggregation node, and aggregation weights (Eq. 16, p. 8); p. 7: "to optimize: 1) the trajectory of each UAV; 2) the pairing". No learned power, beam, or channel decision: transmit powers are fixed constants (p. 10: "power of ground users, UAVs and LEO satellites are 0.1 W,") and only swept in Fig. 9 (p. 12). Aggregation is digital hierarchical federated learning across UAVs and satellites, with weights applied at the edge and cloud servers (Eqs. 11-13, p. 6), not over-the-air, so the function check (code 5) would also fail. The PDF is the arXiv preprint 2408.02501v1 with the title of the JSAC paper; the DOI is not printed in it.
